headword: {宇宙飛行士|うちゅうひこうし}

definitions.explanation: A person trained to travel and work in outer space aboard a spacecraft.

examples.japanese: {将来|しょうらい}{宇宙飛行士|うちゅうひこうし}になりたい。
examples.english: I want to become an astronaut in the future.

examples.japanese: その{宇宙飛行士|うちゅうひこうし}は{半年|はんとし}{宇宙|うちゅう}に{滞在|たいざい}した。
examples.english: That astronaut stayed in space for half a year.

examples.japanese: {日本人|にほんじん}の{宇宙飛行士|うちゅうひこうし}が{国際|こくさい}{宇宙|うちゅう}ステーションで{実験|じっけん}を{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: A Japanese astronaut conducted experiments on the International Space Station.

notes:
Compound of {宇宙|うちゅう} (space) + {飛行士|ひこうし} (aviator, flier).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宇宙飛行士|うちゅうひこうし}になる: to become an astronaut
- {宇宙飛行士|うちゅうひこうし}{候補|こうほ}: astronaut candidate
- ベテランの{宇宙飛行士|うちゅうひこうし}: veteran astronaut

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {飛行士|ひこうし}: aviator; pilot — flies aircraft within the atmosphere
- {宇宙|うちゅう}{飛行|ひこう}: spaceflight — the act of flying in space, not the person
